column1: DFM software evaluation scorecard (from the Emithran DFM software guide)
Score each line 0-2 (0 = no, 1 = partly, 2 = yes) during demos and the pilot. Maximum 34. Above about 26 (75%) suggests a strong fit - adjust to your priorities.

column2: Covers the processes you use most
Rules can be adjusted to match your suppliers
Works with your CAD systems and file types
Handles assemblies as well as single parts
Flags are specific: feature, reason and suggested fix
Issues are ranked by importance, not just listed
Engineers can see the logic behind each flag
Results have been checked against a real part you know well
Each issue shows an effect on cost
Cost assumptions are visible and editable
Estimates have been compared with real quotes
Feedback arrives while the design can still change
Results can be shared with manufacturing, sourcing and design
Setup and training time is realistic for your team
Data security and deployment options meet your rules
Clear pricing, including what happens as users and parts grow

column1: PILOT (4-6 weeks on one product line)
Design changes made because of the tool
Estimated cost saved by those changes
Engineers still using it at the end
Analysis time on your most complex part
